olders.part: §3 "Before it asks, the drive builds the memory it lacks" (as amended by ADR 042): the work is one step of the loop, run by the knowledge-builder agent with skills, the memory tool and the loop's scripts, not member plays · §4 "Member plays" (as amended by ADR 042 and, per its pointer, ADR 043): a loop has no member plays; the knowledge step is a step of the loop; the change plays a loop runs stay as they are · §5 "The person's questions, when they come" (as amended by ADR 042): restated here — the person gets the knowledge brief, never a questionnaire

§2 "A play is a pure workflow and reads no memory" and §10's line on ADR 035 §4 ("only agents call the tool"), as amended by ADR 042: the one read-only exception — a script may ask the memory tool's `updates` for the issue's waiting memory updates — passes from "a knowledge play's own check script" to the Discovery loop's scripts `check_knowledge.py` and `round_state.py` (round_state.py stops reading memory-update files by path). The rest of §2 stands and is now kept: no skill calls the memory tool (author-knowledge-page stops calling `propose`; the agent raises the page).

§1 "The Shared Drive Run owns the steps between plays" (as renamed by ADR 045): its list of run steps gains the knowledge step (R5c: close the open questions; R5b: show the knowledge brief and record the reply). It is a run step, not a product rule, so §1's rule that a loop carries no product rules of its own stands.

§4 "Plays take the verb of what they do", the clause "knowledge plays `search`, `research`, `check`": there are no knowledge plays. `check` stays a change-play verb (check-change); `search` and `research` are no longer play verbs. The skill verb `research` (§5) stands.
